page.title: Macbeth (thane)
page.meta_description: Macbeth is the soldier-thane whose ambition, the witches' speech, and Lady Macbeth's urging turn a loyal subject into the tyrant Macduff finally kills.…
page.content:
Thane of Glamis and Cawdor who murders Duncan to take the crown.

How Macbeth (thane) connects

  • Work: Macbeth — The thane is the title figure of Macbeth.
  • Character: Lady Macbeth — Lady Macbeth goads Macbeth into killing the king.

What is Macbeth (thane)?

Macbeth is the soldier-thane whose ambition, the witches' speech, and Lady Macbeth's urging turn a loyal subject into the tyrant Macduff finally kills.

Key threads lead to Macbeth and Lady Macbeth.
